rosterBasis.policy: The user-provided 2026-08-23 LEC roster snapshot is the identity basis. Public-profile lag or recent-transfer differences are recorded explicitly without silently replacing a requested player.

semantics.contract: Only a publicly verifiable current expiration date is included. Salary, buyout, contract start, and inferred terms are excluded.
semantics.career: Public team-history periods with source date precision retained.
semantics.honors: Major public team achievements and individual awards; not every minor event, weekly award, or placement.
semantics.prizeMoney: Approximate public cumulative tournament winnings in USD; not salary, bonus, buyout, or market value.
semantics.age: Completed age as of 2026-08-24. Age is null when no exact public birth date is available.
